transcript.text: I have some operational information that I think is critical before we finalize this. I ran a classroom trial with all of my 9th-grade sections and recorded 23 phone-related interruptions in just two weeks. I also tested numbered locking pouches, and they significantly reduced interruptions. Based on that, I recommended in my team notes a grade-9-only pilot using one pouch per student — but those notes haven't been added to the draft proposal yet. I think the committee should consider this data before we settle on the open-bin approach for both grades 9 and 10.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an important operational concern. Two students have active safety plans requiring them to receive time-sensitive messages from their caregivers during the school day. I confirmed the plans with both families this week, but the exception has not been entered in the pilot procedure yet. If we're requiring phones to go into open classroom bins, we need to make sure there's a documented exception process for these students before any student-facing procedures are approved.
